transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

I've been struggling with constant, uncontrollable worry and anxiety for about a year and two months now. It feels like I'm worrying all the time and I just can't seem to turn it off. That's why I decided to come in today to get some help.
Have you also been having symptoms like restlessness, feeling on edge, muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or difficulty concentrating most days?
I haven't really noticed physical symptoms like muscle tension or trouble sleeping. But my mind is constantly racing with worries, which does make it really hard to focus on things sometimes.
Did this worry start after a specific stressful event or life change, or does it feel like it has been present without a clear trigger?
I'm really not sure if there was a specific trigger for it. It feels like this constant worry has just been present for about 14 months now, without any clear event that started it.
Do you find it hard to control the worry, and does it happen about most days across different areas of your life?

Yes, I find it extremely difficult to control or stop the worrying once it starts, even when I try my best to distract myself. It happens almost every single day, and it's not just about one thing—it spreads to everything from my work and finances to my family's well-being.
Have you also been having symptoms like restlessness, feeling on edge, muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or difficulty concentrating most days?

I haven't really experienced those physical symptoms like muscle tension, restlessness, or trouble sleeping. It is mostly just the constant mental worry that occupies my mind and makes it hard to focus.
Have these worries caused problems in your daily life, like at work, in relationships, or with taking care of responsibilities?

Yes, they have definitely caused a lot of problems in my daily life. These worries constantly intrude into my mind, making it incredibly hard to focus on my tasks at work or keep up with my responsibilities. It just feels like the anxiety spreads to everything, from my job and finances to my family, and completely overwhelms me.
Do you also often feel restless or on edge, even if you don't have trouble sleeping or muscle tension?
No, I don't really feel restless or on edge like that. It is mostly just my thoughts constantly racing and worrying, rather than any physical feeling of being on edge.
Have you also been having symptoms like restlessness, feeling on edge, muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or difficulty concentrating most days?

I haven't really noticed physical symptoms like restlessness, muscle tension, or trouble sleeping. However, I do find it very hard to concentrate because my mind is constantly filled with intrusive worries that I can't seem to stop.
Have you also been having symptoms like restlessness, feeling on edge, muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or difficulty concentrating most days?

I haven't really noticed physical symptoms like muscle tension or trouble sleeping. I'm not sure about feeling restless or on edge either. It really is just the constant mental worry that I struggle with.
Have you also been having symptoms like restlessness, feeling on edge, muscle tension, trouble sleeping, or difficulty concentrating most days?
I haven't really noticed those physical symptoms like muscle tension or trouble sleeping. My main struggle is just the constant, uncontrollable mental worrying that I can't seem to turn off.
